items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: I was with him almost two years... Horace Henderson was giving us arrangements for Charlie Barnett.

ctx.x: And then I had my freedom musically, and I was with him almost two years before I went with -- we will get into that little by little, but he made some tremendous things with several Barnet bands, record dates I'm talking about like 'Blue Juice' and 'Charleston Alley' and 'Little Smack' was writing for us then, Horace Henderson was giving us arrangements for Charlie Barnett.
